title: Delay SP_FILE until first packets present
description:
Fixes issue #17013 where a race condition between reporting SP_FILE and
writing the SHB from a pipe source in passthrough mode.  If the capture
parent reads from the capture file before the SHB is written the read
aborts on the empty file.
